name: issueready-workspace
description: Local-first, evidence-backed readiness analysis for existing GitHub tasks.

scripts.cli: corepack pnpm --filter issueready build && node packages/cli/dist/cli.js
scripts.example:check: node examples/evaluate-local-issue.mjs --check && node packages/cli/dist/cli.js demo ready > /dev/null && node packages/cli/dist/cli.js demo needs-info > /dev/null
scripts.format: prettier --write package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml tsconfig.base.json vitest.config.ts .oxlintrc.json README.md CHANGELOG.md CONTRIBUTING.md SECURITY.md SUPPORT.md CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md 'docs/**/*.md' 'examples/**/*.{md,mjs}' 'packages/**/*.{json,md,ts}' 'schemas/**/*.json' 'fixtures/**/*.{json,md,yml,yaml}' 'rules/**/*.json' 'locales/**/*.json' 'scripts/**/*.mjs' 'mutation/**/*.{json,md,mjs}' '.github/**/*.{md,yml,yaml}'
scripts.format:check: prettier --check package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml tsconfig.base.json vitest.config.ts .oxlintrc.json README.md CHANGELOG.md CONTRIBUTING.md SECURITY.md SUPPORT.md CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md 'docs/**/*.md' 'examples/**/*.{md,mjs}' 'packages/**/*.{json,md,ts}' 'schemas/**/*.json' 'fixtures/**/*.{json,md,yml,yaml}' 'rules/**/*.json' 'locales/**/*.json' 'scripts/**/*.mjs' 'mutation/**/*.{json,md,mjs}' '.github/**/*.{md,yml,yaml}'
scripts.mutation: corepack pnpm mutation:decision && corepack pnpm mutation:policy && corepack pnpm mutation:redaction
scripts.validate: corepack pnpm format:check && corepack pnpm assets:check && corepack pnpm lint && corepack pnpm validate:json && corepack pnpm validate:links && corepack pnpm generate:schema-types:check && corepack pnpm generate:rule-catalog:check && corepack pnpm generate:rule-fixtures:check && corepack pnpm mutation:evidence:check && corepack pnpm typecheck && corepack pnpm test && corepack pnpm build && corepack pnpm package:check && corepack pnpm example:check
